cues: Couplet six is the one to memorise: there's more to a people than their poverty; there is their work, their wisdom, their creativity.
Work comes first: this is not sentimental noble poverty, but an economy the poster never photographs.
And the rhyme, poverty with creativity, the poem's only long rhyme, chains together exactly the two words the couplet is arguing about.
